description: A utility module for versioned, multi-algorithm password hashing and verification with tenant-specific salts and global pepper support. Includes functions for hashing, verifying, and ensuring tenant salts, supporting legacy (v1) and current (v2) schemes with fallbacks to scrypt, bcrypt, and argon2.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the global password pepper from environment variables.

methods.name: buildHashInput
methods.description: Constructs the input string for hashing based on version, tenant, and environment.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using the preferred scheme (Argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt fallback) for version 2.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy static salt with scrypt, for verification of existing hashes.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash, determining algorithm by hash format and supporting migration.

methods.name: compareHash
methods.description: Compares a password input with a stored hash using the appropriate algorithm.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures a tenant has an orgSalt, generating and saving one if missing.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password with specified version (defaults to v2).

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies password and provides migration to current scheme if needed.
